summary: This closes real gaps from the round-1 review: OWNER_ENGINE's new --mode owner-dispatch / route_and_dispatch() now calls task-gateway.py submit/start/status via subprocess arg-lists (no shell=True, no injection risk), gated by a genuine NEEDS_OWNER_CLARIFICATION check and a duplicate_found block before auto-firing start, and task-gateway.py's cmd_start now actually calls credit-accountant.py propose (previously missing, which broke the worker's later report --increment call) with a --repo value that is safe because argparse enforces --repo required=True on the start subcommand -- confirmed by reading build_parser(). The REQUIRED_SECTIONS/FIELD_HEADER_RE dedup into workflow_contract.REQUIRED_TASK_SECTIONS removes a real drift risk, and the confidence-is-None fix in query.py closes a genuine TypeError on document-mode chats. All 23 repo tests pass locally (12 in the new integration file, 4 of which correctly skip when the live-only credit-accountant.py isn't present in this checkout), and the diff stays fully additive/new-path with no touches to migrations, auth, payment, .env, or .github/workflows -- consistent with its tier1 classification. One non-blocking correctness gap worth a follow-up: determine_lifecycle_route()'s status-query check (STATUS_QUERY_WORDS_RE) runs before the has_all_required_sections() check and matches any occurrence of words like 'done'/'complete'/'status' anywhere in the raw text, not just in reference to the task_id found -- a full new task spec that happens to mention an old task_id in KNOWN_CONTEXT alongside one of those common words would be silently routed to a read-only status query instead of being dispatched. This fails safe (a missed dispatch, not a wrongful action) rather than causing harm, so it doesn't block approval.
issues: determine_lifecycle_route()'s status-query branch (STATUS_QUERY_WORDS_RE) is checked before the full-spec/has_all_required_sections() branch and matches common words anywhere in the text, so a complete task spec that references an old task_id plus an incidental word like 'done' or 'complete' will be misrouted to a status query instead of dispatched -- fails safe (missed dispatch) but should be tightened in a follow-up.

This round further expands OWNER_ENGINE's autonomy to auto-trigger real production side effects (systemd start, credit-accountant spend) directly from heuristic chat classification with no AI/human judgment step in between beyond the new clarification and duplicate gates -- worth watching in live operation for false-positive auto-starts, though the added gates are a reasonable mitigation for this round.
